posts.text: SpaceX could bring in $1 trillion in revenue by 2030. And I would be surprised if revenue is not greater than $1T in 2031.
posts.caption: SpaceX could bring in $1 trillion in revenue by 2030. And I would be surprised if revenue is not greater than $1T in 2031.

posts.text: Given the complexity of these changes in AI, we've made mistakes and will almost certainly make more. I'm focused on providing as much stability as possible as we build the future of superintelligence.
posts.caption: Given the complexity of these changes in AI, we've made mistakes and will almost certainly make more. I'm focused on providing as much stability as possible as we build the future of superintelligence.

posts.text: AI is the most profound platform shift of our lifetimes. It's lighting up every part of our business, driving an expansionary moment in Search, turbocharging Cloud and much more.
posts.caption: AI is the most profound platform shift of our lifetimes. It's lighting up every part of our business, driving an expansionary moment in Search, turbocharging Cloud and much more.

posts.text: In my view, our priority has to be building a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model, so value flows broadly across every company, every industry, and every country. One where every organisation can own the learning loop that encodes its institutional knowledge.
posts.caption: In my view, our priority has to be building a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model, so value flows broadly across every company, every industry, and every country. One where every organisation can own the learning loop that encodes its institutional knowledge.

posts.text: This is the beginning of a third phase for OpenAI. Filing now gives us optionality if we want to go sooner — but our focus stays on building AI that helps people get more value for less.
posts.caption: This is the beginning of a third phase for OpenAI. Filing now gives us optionality if we want to go sooner — but our focus stays on building AI that helps people get more value for less.

posts.text: With the incredible capabilities we introduced today, and so many more still to come, I truly believe the best is still ahead. Creating the best products to enrich people's lives has always been our North Star.
posts.caption: With the incredible capabilities we introduced today, and so many more still to come, I truly believe the best is still ahead. Creating the best products to enrich people's lives has always been our North Star.

posts.text: All the CPUs of the past, we built for humans. This CPU is built for agents. Every layer of the computing stack is being reinvented for the age of AI agents.
posts.caption: All the CPUs of the past, we built for humans. This CPU is built for agents. Every layer of the computing stack is being reinvented for the age of AI agents.

posts.text: I really see AI agents on an open network as the fundamental construct for massive diffusion of technology. India should focus on becoming the use case capital of the world.
posts.caption: I really see AI agents on an open network as the fundamental construct for massive diffusion of technology. India should focus on becoming the use case capital of the world.

posts.text: I support the release of all the files and hope my participation contributes to getting justice for the victims. Meeting Epstein was a grave error in judgment on my part.

posts.text: Over the next decade, AI will surpass today's boldest expectations, driving a tenfold productivity revolution and long-term transformation. But the advantage will go to those who start early.
posts.caption: Over the next decade, AI will surpass today's boldest expectations, driving a tenfold productivity revolution and long-term transformation. But the advantage will go to those who start early.

posts.text: Adobe delivered record revenue of $6.62 billion in Q2, reflecting strong AI-driven demand across our customer groups. Removing friction from onboarding is the right bet to reach a far larger audience with Firefly and Express.

posts.text: Agents will use the web a thousand times more than humans ever have, and most of that work will happen in the background. Agents are here. The web's second user is online.
posts.caption: Agents will use the web a thousand times more than humans ever have, and most of that work will happen in the background. Agents are here. The web's second user is online.

posts.text: AI is everywhere and it is going to be transformative in our world, so luxury has to engage with it, Chanel has to engage with it as all others. My number one focus is to keep a relentless focus on human creation — AI should support human creators, not take away what they bring.

posts.text: The physical scale and reach of the FedEx global network generates more than 2 petabytes of data daily. By bringing our strengths together with AI, we are improving customer workflows and making supply chains smarter for everyone.
